description: Design-token architecture — build, name, theme, and govern a design-token system the way the field's canonical sources converge on it. Covers the three-tier model (primitive/semantic/component), naming grammar, OKLCH color scales, DTCG authoring, Style Dictionary pipelines, dark-mode/multi-brand/density theming, CSS-variable distribution, WCAG contrast gates, and token semver/deprecation.
name: stark-design
